text:
Jules (People Ops): Quick thread 1: Yara is currently on STEM OPT and her EAD renewal is pending. Shes asking if we can (a) provide an employer letter to support USCIS expedite (client go-live impact) and (b) confirm start/pay/benefits contingency if the EAD isn't processed by the projected start date. Can we triage?
Eric M (Recruiter): Offer signed with provisional start date June 15. Candidate indicated EAD file (I-765) is pending and USCIS case number provided in DM. Yara asked if company can write a "notice of employment" stating intended start and duties for expedite.
Nina (Hiring Manager): Role blurb: "Yara will be Senior Backend Engineer, Serving Runtime team, owning batching/caching improvements for low-latency inference. She's the only engineer with prior quantization-inference experience for this customer P0." Need that in the letter to stress criticality.
Avery (Immigration Counsel): USCIS expedite criteria are narrow: severe financial loss to company or person, emergent humanitarian reasons, or urgent humanitarian/ public interest. A client go-live could qualify if we can show real, immediate financial harm. We can draft an "urgent support letter" documenting the go-live date, financial impact estimate, and duties. Provide numbers/POC.
Sam (Payroll): Payroll note: we can't put someone on payroll without EAD authorization. If start is delayed > 30 days we need to postpone benefits enrollment cutoff. No retroactive pay until authorization. We can, however, prepare onboarding paperwork and benefits enrollment forms to be activated once EAD confirmed.
Yara (candidate): Confirmed she filed I-765 on Apr 2; receipt number ends with 1234. She asked if Redwood can request USCIS expedite and whether the company will reimburse travel if consular or biometrics require in-person.
Jules (People Ops): For expedite we need a signed company letter on letterhead, a manager statement quantifying impact, and Legal/Immig approval. Avery, can you draft language? Nina, can you provide a short financial impact figure or customer penalty if we miss go-live?
Nina (Hiring Manager): Customer SLA has liquidated damages of ~USD 80k/month if we miss the integration deadline (June 1). Yara's work removes the final performance blocker. I can provide a JIRA ticket list and a manager attestation.
Avery (Immigration Counsel): I'll assemble the letter: 1) attestation of role & start date; 2) description of urgent business need and financial harm (use Nina's figures); 3) confirmation the candidate's role is unique and not immediately replaceable; 4) request for USCIS expedite. Will route to Legal for sign-off.
Eric M (Recruiter): Yara also asked about paid leave for necessary biometrics/USCIS appointments. Can we confirm?
Jules (People Ops): Yes, company policy: paid time off for immigration appointments related to new hire processing; we'll include that in the letter. Also note: if EAD takes >60 days past start, we will convert to contractor contingency or delay start per policy. Need to be explicit in onboarding comms.
Sam (Payroll): To be clear: no payroll until EAD card shows; but we'll hold start date in HRIS and trigger payroll once EAD is uploaded. Benefits enrollment will be queued pending active payroll.
Yara (candidate): Appreciate clarity. Also asked whether Redwood can file I-765 expedite or if she must request it as applicant.
Avery (Immigration Counsel): USCIS allows either the applicant or an employer to request expedite. We will submit a company-signed expedite request and cover any legal costs for drafting. Should include supporting docs: signed offer, manager attestation, client PO or contract excerpt showing go-live, and any financial estimate.
legal-bot: Reminder: Legal must review all expedite packets and sign the company letter. Allow 24 business hours for review; include points of contact for USCIS follow-up.
Jules (People Ops): Action items: 1) Nina to DM manager attestation + PO/contract excerpt; 2) Avery to draft letter and route to Legal; 3) Eric to keep candidate updated and collect EAD receipt number (done); 4) Payroll to prepare onboarding hold states. Target: submit expedite request by Apr 18 EOD. Please ack when complete.
Nina (Hiring Manager): Ack 1 DMing attestation and PO excerpt now.
Avery (Immigration Counsel): Ack 1 drafting letter and will tag Legal.
Sam (Payroll): Ack 1 prepping HRIS hold and benefits notes.
Eric M (Recruiter): Ack 1 updating candidate and collecting docs.
Yara (candidate): Ack 1 thanks everyone for the help.
